title: fix(sessions): filtered export includes ended pinned sessions
claim: `hermes sessions export <out> --<filter>` reuses list_prune_candidates, whose _prune_filter_where defaults include_pinned=False, so filtered (read-only) exports silently drop ended pinned sessions that bare export and --session-id include.

evidence.red: Defect confirmed on MAIN by direct probe: real SessionDB with 3 ended source=cli sessions (pinned, unpinned, pinned+archived); hermes_cli.sessions_cmd._cmd_export(db, args --source cli --format jsonl) -> 'Exported 1 sessions'; exported ids = [unpinned only]; PINNED in: False, ARCHIVED_PINNED in: False.
evidence.source: MAIN hermes_cli/sessions_cmd.py _cmd_export L322-332 sets filters['archived']=None but never include_pinned; L356 (jsonl/html/only), L444 (_export_trace) and _export_markdown all call db.list_prune_candidates(**filters); hermes_state_maintenance.py L199/L226-227 `if not include_pinned: clauses.append('COALESCE(s.pinned, 0) = 0')`.
evidence.fork_tests_on_main: Fork's committed test file run test-only on MAIN fails for the WRONG reasons: dispatch test captures {} (stub no longer intercepted), e2e test FileNotFoundError on backup.jsonl because monkeypatching hermes_state.SessionDB no longer reaches cmd_sessions. Fork tests are stale and would need rework (call _cmd_export(db, args) directly).

upstream_overlap: #99487 OPEN alissonrgalindo 'fix(sessions): include open and pinned sessions in filtered exports' (created 2026-08-31, labels type/bug P2 area/sessions): sets filters['include_pinned']=True for exports plus a new list_export_candidates that also includes open sessions; has CLI test asserting include_pinned is True. Currently CONFLICTS with MAIN in session_filters.py, sessions_cmd.py, hermes_state.py (hermes_state decomposition drift).
#89226 OPEN liuhao1024 'include open sessions in bulk exports' / issue #89223 OPEN (open-session half only, not pinned).
notes: Support opportunity: #99487 has only a filters-dict assertion; fork #25's idea of a real-SessionDB end-to-end check (pinned + pinned-archived rows actually land in the JSONL) is the missing behavioral test, and the 1-line include_pinned override is a minimal fallback if #99487's broader open-session change stalls. Offer as review support to #99487, not a competing PR. Fork test needs rework before reuse (see evidence).
